scope: Independent read-only project event history, protocol 3 shared-state compatibility, publisher/subscriber provenance and async source ownership.
checks: Independent event panel consumes a detached core-admitted event snapshot without raw log parsing, networking, publishing or subscription ports.
Protocol 3 shows event history and unchanged shared state; protocol 2 shows shared state only; protocol 1 retains its prior presentation.
Published entries preserve sequence, name, scalar payload and publisher source; recipients separately show pending, handled or skipped status and their own subscription source.
No recipients is explicitly displayed and is not interpreted as a successful callback.
Scene changes preserve history and event-name filtering; new tasks clear both.

Appended history preserves existing source tickets and focused DOM nodes; a changed recipient status at the same publication sequence revokes that recipient ticket without revoking the publisher or another recipient.
Past publisher/subscriber origins retain frozen declaration UUID, source revision and property path instead of the actor UUID or current scene.
Busy blocks click admission and duplicate navigation, while the host own-loading busy phase does not revoke an admitted read; dirty, creating, task and visit changes do revoke it.
Authored text, Unicode, markup, false, zero and empty strings remain literal across Chinese, English and Japanese.
Dedicated responsive stylesheet uses a single column below 600px and wraps long author content.
JavaScript syntax and git diff --check passed.
limits: The 99 tests include 82 existing observation/build/language regressions and 17 new event tests; counts overlap earlier incremental runs.
DOM-controller admission uses the real protocol 3 core query; actual browser layout, Godot execution and relocated ZIP delivery are separate evidence.
Frozen binding origins currently provide document/property provenance without sourceRange, so these source actions promise document navigation, not a fabricated exact selection.
